title: Cross-domain real-time coordination interface
description: Sources establish separate aviation-safety and spectrum responsibilities and demonstrate coordination/data sharing, but the corpus does not identify one standardized machine-readable interface for exchanging live aircraft/5G risk state and authorized mitigation actions.

title: Machine-readable authorization for dynamic network actions
description: The corpus defines management/orchestration and spectrum authority constraints, but does not establish a universal machine-readable policy interface an autonomous optimizer can query before changing RF/network parameters in aviation-sensitive areas.

title: Jurisdiction/version-aware policy reasoning
description: India, US and European evidence shows evolving and jurisdiction-specific approaches. The policy agent therefore needs explicit jurisdiction, effective-date and supersession logic.

title: Evidence-backed dynamic safety-margin model
description: Authoritative guidance identifies relevant RF/geometry/propagation variables, but the simulator still needs a transparent model mapping those variables to a numeric safety-margin score. That score must remain labelled simulation/model output.

title: Common telecom-aviation ontology
description: Different authorities use different vocabularies. A shared ontology for cell, antenna, aircraft, protected area, spectrum assignment, constraint, authorization and mitigation action is needed for reliable agent retrieval/arbitration.

title: India airport-area 5G restriction parameters not found in primary sources
description: Press cites DGCA/DoT interim restrictions near airports but the KB holds no primary text with exclusion distances, power or tilt limits. Needed before any India-specific numeric constraint can be enforced. Action: obtain DoT/DGCA circulars.

title: India has no numeric RA tolerance threshold in AIC 19/2025
description: Appendices define tolerance qualitatively; the US ITM (CLM-104/109) is the only numeric public benchmark in the KB. Using it for India is an analogy, not a legal requirement.

title: Temporal gap: India limitations not yet effective
description: Between today and 2027-12-31 India has no in-force numeric/aircraft-category restriction in the KB; agents must reason over effective dates (extends GAP-003).

title: Controlled/blocked primary texts
description: ICAO guidance (MID-Doc-015), ICAO WP/NACC papers, ITU-R M.2059 numbers, FCC R&O, NFAP-2025 body, Telecom Act text and 3GPP TS 23.501/23.502/28.xxx clause text were not ingested (blocked, licensed or not fetched).

description: Needed so the Optimization agent only proposes actions the Network agent can show are actuable; ingest TS 28.541 RET/antenna objects, O-RAN/vendor APIs, and measured actuation latency.
